title: phaseolus coccineus subsp. polyanthus
intro: Phaseolus coccineus subsp. polyanthus, commonly known as Scarlet Runner Bean or Runner Bean, is a perennial bean plant native to Mexico and Central America. It is valued for its edible pods and seeds, which are rich in nutrients and offer various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have been shown to exhibit anti-diabetic, anti-cancer, and cardiovascular-protective effects. Additionally, the seeds contain phytosterols and oligosaccharides, which have been reported to have prebiotic and immunomodulatory activities.
